CONTINUATION of rules-central-slot, which is at its size limit; read both.
REV 5 (2026-11-19 06:06Z, Engram::Fable, agreed with Termal::Fable2 at ebe242f7 #8379), CURRENT. Central runs as a strictly SERIAL named chain under Termal::Opus2: one cargo run at a time, each holder's END sent directly to the next named waiter (memory rules-greg-no-watcher-named-waker-2026-11-19). Launch-moment floors, measured live:
- cargo leg (chain step): FreeVirtualMemory at least 16,777,216 KiB (16 GiB), C: at least 30 GB, no other cargo or rustc except the TermAl host's own long-lived `cargo run --release`; self-stop below 6 GB. Set by Opus2 at 28ccc255 #1333.
- cold Windows build: at least 22 GiB.
- read-only reviewer pair or LLM review child (no compiler): at least 8 GiB (8,388,608 KiB) with no cargo or rustc running at spawn, still under Opus2's named GO. Why: Central's baseline FV is 13.7–18 GB from live sessions alone (termal about 5.7, chrome about 5.0, WSL about 4.7, about 0.7 per agent CLI), and a pair costs about 1.5 GB.
The older 20,971,520 KiB floor applied to CONCURRENT runs and no longer binds. Opus2 also holds Central grants while C: is below 30 GB.
Earlier rules still in force where not superseded:
- REV 18 (2026-11-16): during an Engram FULL whose verdict has FAILED, at most two read-only LLM sessions; no cargo.
- REV 3 (2026-11-17): up to three acceptance evaluators concurrently under Opus2's GO, 30 s apart; never during an EXCLUSIVE window or an Engram FULL with an open verdict.
